title: Vakil-Friend extracted case data
description: Structured case-filing data extracted from a Vakil-Friend conversation. GroqResponseValidator loads this at startup and VakilFriendGroqValidatorService validates against it before anything is written to CaseEntity or FirRecord; a payload that fails goes through a bounded Groq repair loop and, failing that, is flagged for manual correction. Field names and allowed values must stay in step with VakilFriendGroqValidatorService#toSchemaNode and the repair prompt it sends.

title.description: Short case title. toSchemaNode substitutes an empty string when extraction found nothing, so minLength 1 is what routes an incomplete extraction into the repair loop.

description.description: Narrative of the dispute as collected from the litigant.

caseType.description: The five categories the Vakil-Friend system prompt asks the litigant to choose from.

petitioner.description: Full name of the person filing.

respondent.description: Party the case is filed against.

target.description: POLICE routes the filing to an FIR record, COURT to a case.
